title.value: Intelligent Tutoring Systems Will Transform Online Learning for Millions
title.justification: The paper discusses the impact of intelligent tutoring systems on improving online learning outcomes.
title.quote: In this paper, we present the results of a comparative head-to-head study on learning outcomes for two popular online learning platforms... The results demonstrate the tremendous impact that can be achieved with a personalized, active learning AI-powered system.

extractions.description: The paper examines how AI-powered intelligent tutoring systems (ITS) can enhance online learning by providing personalized, active learning experiences. Using the Korbit learning platform as a case study, the paper compares learning outcomes between a traditional MOOC platform and Korbit, highlighting significant improvements in student performance when personalized feedback is provided. The study suggests that ITS can democratize access to high-quality education, aligning with the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) for inclusive education.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper emphasizes the role of AI-powered educational systems in democratizing education and making high-quality learning accessible, aligning with the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: If such a personalized and active learning experience can be made available to millions of learners around the world, then this advance would represent a significant step towards the democratization of education in accordance with the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals.

primary_category.justification: While the paper discusses the democratization of education and aligns with SDGs, it doesn't directly connect to climate or ecological sustainable development themes.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we have argued for the effectiveness of personalization and active learning strategies in ITS. If such a personalized and active learning experience can be made accessible to millions of learners around the world, then this advance would represent a huge leap forward towards the democratization of education in accordance with the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals.

secondary_categories.justification: The discussion of making high-quality education accessible aligns with the broader context of supporting the Global South through improved educational opportunities.
secondary_categories.quote: This implies that AI researchers must focus their efforts on the application of AI to improve the quality of education, in particular in the context of online learning systems. ITS (intelligent tutoring systems) are a viable, scalable solution that can provide high-quality education, substantially surpassing the capabilities of platforms that do not allow for personalization and active learning.

primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-category themes do not align directly with climate or ecological factors but rather focus on education technology and its scalability globally.
primary_sub_category.quote: Based on experimental evidence with nearly 200 students, we have shown that personalization and active learning in ITS can have a huge impact on both student learning outcomes and student motivation.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The focus on democratizing access to education and aligning with SDGs supports broader policy advice and knowledge sharing initiatives
secondary_sub_categories.quote: One of the solutions proposed are online learning plat- forms providing large numbers of students with access to learning material on various subjects, with Massive Online Open Courses (MOOCs) being a notable example.
